# Introduction

The goals of this R Markdown document are to:

* Rasie national lfd to the international landings and calculate fishery summary table.
* Write TAF data tables

Files before (inside "data/intercatch"):

* fu17.int.land.csv
* NepLand.WGNEPH2026.csv
* fu17.nat.qlfd.all.wg2026.csv

Files after (inside "model_01"):

* fu17.international_landings.csv
* fu17.national_landings.csv
* fu17_Int.lfd.png
* fu17_meanld.csv
* fu17_fishery_summary.csv
* fu17_National_landings_qtr.png
* fu17.int.qlfd.csv


## National Landings Revisions.
<a href="#top">Back to top</a>


```{r nat land, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, fig.height=7, fig.width=12, warning=FALSE, fig.cap="FU17 Irish  Landings (t) by quarter."}

nat <- read.csv("boot/data/intercatch/NepLand_WGNEPH2026.csv")
str(nat)
nat$LiveWt <-as.numeric(as.character(nat$LiveWt))
nat$LiveWtRaisedToDecs <-as.numeric(as.character(nat$LiveWtRaisedToDecs))
aggregate(LiveWt/1000 ~ Year + FU, nat, sum)

nat$Quarter <- as.factor(nat$Quarter)
nat <- nat %>% filter(FU=='17')
  
ggplot(nat, aes(as.factor(Year), LiveWt/1000, fill=factor(Quarter))) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position= "stack") + 
  theme_bw() + ylab("Landings (tonnes)") + 
  #ylim(c(0,1500)) +
  labs(fill = "Quarter") +
  xlab("Year") +
  theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank())

nl <- nat %>% group_by(Year, Quarter) %>% summarise(tot =sum(LiveWt)) 

nl <- nl %>% spread( Quarter, -Year) 
nl$Total<- rowSums(nl[,2:5], na.rm=TRUE)

knitr::kable(nl , digits=2)


if (save.plots == T) {
  ggsave("model/model_01_raising_to_international/FU17_National_Landings_qtr.png")
}

 if (save.tables == T) {
   write.csv(nl, "model/model_01_raising_to_international/fu17.national.landings.csv", row.names = F)
   }

```

qlfd.wg <- read.csv("boot/data/intercatch/fu17.nat.qlfd.all.taf.2026.csv")
```



## Now the International Raising Factor
<a href="#top">Back to top</a>

Sampling review 2026 - raised discards 
Calculate annual raising factor.
Plot proportions of Irish landings in the fishery.
Create international raised data file.

```{r raising int, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

int.dat <- qlfd.wg %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(lan.wgt =sum(rlan.wt.r), dis.wgt =sum(rdis.wt.r))
                                           
int.dat <- left_join(int, int.dat, by="year")

int.dat$rf.lan <- with(int.dat, total/lan.wgt)   

int.dat <- int.dat %>% mutate_all(funs(replace(., is.na(.), 0)))                

so <- read.csv("boot/data/intercatch/stock_overview.csv")

so <- so %>%
  filter(Catch.Cat. == "Discards") %>%
  group_by(Country, Fleets, Year) %>%
  summarise(total_discards = sum(Catch..kg, na.rm = TRUE)/1000, .groups = "drop")


so <- so %>% group_by(Year) %>% summarise(int.discards = sum(total_discards))

#filling missing years
so_updated <- so  %>%
  complete(Year = 1974:2025, fill = list(int.discards = 0)) %>%
  arrange(Year) %>% rename(year = Year)

#merge so_updated into int.dat
int.dat <- left_join(int.dat, so_updated, by="year")

#new rf discrd column
int.dat$rf.discard <- with(int.dat, int.discards/dis.wgt)

#If rf.discrd is 0 replace it with 1
int.dat <- int.dat %>%
  mutate(rf.discard = ifelse(rf.discard == 0, 1, rf.discard))

#Replace NAs
int.dat <- int.dat %>% mutate_all(funs(replace(., is.na(.), 0))) 


#Join
dat <- left_join(qlfd.wg, int.dat, by="year")


dat$rdis.num <- with(dat, rdis.n.r*rf.discard)
dat$rlan.num <- with(dat, rlan.n.r*rf.lan)
dat$rdis.wt <- with(dat, rdis.wt.r*rf.discard)
dat$rlan.wt <- with(dat, rlan.wt.r*rf.lan)


#check numbers
check <- dat %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(int.lan.num =sum(rlan.num), #2996.7
                                      int.lan.wgt =sum(rlan.wt),
                                      int.dis.num =sum(rdis.num),
                                      int.dis.wgt =sum(rdis.wt))
knitr::kable(check , digits=5)

 if (save.tables == T) {
   write.csv(dat, "model/model_01_raising_to_international/fu17.int.qlfd.review.csv",  sep=",", row.names = F)
 }

```

## Assessment Summary data table - I think stop here - rest was wo up and showing review (may need to delete after this chunk)
<a href="#top">Back to top</a>

First calculate exploitation pattern.
Landings and discards by weight (tonne) and number ('000s).
Estimated mean weight (gr) in landings and discards.
Discard rates by weight (tonne) and number ('000s) from the raised derived data using the annual discard ogive.
Removals in number.
Dead discard rate by weight (tonne) and number ('000s). 
Proportion Removals retained by number ('000s).
Discard survival estimated as 25%.
```{r summary table}
summ <- dat %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(int.lan.num =sum(rlan.num)/1000, 
                                              int.lan.wgt =sum(rlan.wt),
                                              int.dis.num =sum(rdis.num)/1000,
                                              int.dis.wgt =sum(rdis.wt))  %>%
                                    mutate  (mw.lan = (int.lan.wgt/int.lan.num),
                                             mw.dis = (int.dis.wgt/int.dis.num),
                                             dis.rn = int.dis.num/(int.lan.num + int.dis.num),
                                             dis.rw = int.dis.wgt/(int.lan.wgt + int.dis.wgt),
                                             removals.n = (int.dis.num * 0.75 + int.lan.num),
                                             dead.disc.r = 1-int.lan.num/removals.n,
                                             dead.disc.wgt = int.dis.wgt * 0.75,
                                             prop.removals.ret =int.lan.num/removals.n)


knitr::kable(summ , digits=3)

if (save.tables == T) {
   write.csv(summ, "model/model_01_raising_to_international/fu17.fishery.summary.int.raise.review.csv",  row.names = F)
 }
```

## Assessment summary (discards raised to interational)

```{r dat, echo=TRUE, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}


tv <- read.csv("boot/data/intercatch/FU17.total.abund.estimates.csv")
tv <- tv %>% rename(year = Year)

#exp <- merge(summ, tv[,c("year", "upper", "abund", "lower")], by = "year")

# Interpolate 2021 and 2023 abundance values for 2022 (no survey)
tv$abund[tv$year == 2022] <- mean(tv$abund[tv$year %in% c(2021, 2023)]) 

# Interpolate 2021 and 2023 upper and lower abundance values for 2022 (no survey) - added for getting CI values hr
tv$lower[tv$year == 2022] <- mean(tv$lower[tv$year %in% c(2021, 2023)])
tv$upper[tv$year == 2022] <- mean(tv$upper[tv$year %in% c(2021, 2023)])

tv$ci <- with(tv, abs(abund-upper))
#exp$harvest.rate <- with(exp, removals.n/abund)*100


# calculate hr
exp <- right_join(int.full, tv, by="year") %>% mutate(hr = removals.n/abund*100,
                                                  hr.lower =  removals.n/upper*100,
                                                  hr.higher =  removals.n/lower*100)

exp$ogive <- 'annual'

exp <- exp %>%
  rename(
    harvest.rate = hr,
    harvest.rate.lower = hr.lower,
    harvest.rate.upper = hr.higher
  )

#put in same format for report/adg same 
fu17.exp <- exp[c("year", "int.lan.num", "int.dis.num", "int.lan.wgt", "int.dis.wgt", "removals.n", "prop.removals.ret", "dead.disc.r", "dis.rn", "dis.rw", "mw.lan", "mw.dis", "abund", "ci", "upper", "lower", "harvest.rate",  "process")]

#Sort data 
fu17.exp <- fu17.exp %>% arrange(year)


knitr::kable(fu17.exp[ ,c(1:8)] , digits=3)
knitr::kable(fu17.exp[ ,c(1, 9:18)] , digits=3)

```


# discard rate by weight and number plot
```{r dat1, echo=TRUE, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}


dat1 <- exp %>%
  filter(year %in% 2008:2026) %>%
  select("year","dis.rn", "dis.rw", "process")

knitr::kable(
  dat1 %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = process, values_from = c( "dis.rn", "dis.rw")),
  digits = 4
)

 dat.wide <-  dat1 %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = process, values_from = c( "dis.rn", "dis.rw"))
 
 write.csv(dat.wide, "dat.wide.csv")

dat_long <- dat1 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("dis.rn", "dis.rw"), 
               names_to = "type", 
               values_to = "value")


d <- ggplot(dat_long, aes(year, value, group = process, colour=factor(process))) + 
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  ylab("Discard rate (%)") +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim= c(0, 1), xlim=c(2008, 2026)) +
  scale_x_continuous(name="\nYear",
                     breaks = seq(min(as.numeric(as.character(dat_long$year))),
                                  max(as.numeric(as.character(dat_long$year))), by = 3)) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(name = "Type", option = "D", end = 0.9) +  # Using color-blind friendly palette
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12),
        axis.title=element_text(size=12),
        legend.title=element_blank(),
        panel.grid=element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") + facet_wrap(~ type) 
  

d



if (save.plots == T) {
  ggsave("FU17_Discard_rate_RF_review.png")
}
```

#  catch options revised
Raised correctly based on submitted Intercatch data

```{r dat3, echo=TRUE, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}

curr.year <- 2025


# full range for Aran - for the mean estimations
land.wt.yrs <- seq(2008,curr.year-1,1)
land.wt.yrs
disc.wt.yrs <- seq(2008,curr.year-1,1)
disc.wt.yrs

discard.rate.yrs <- seq(curr.year-3, curr.year-1,1)
dead.discard.rate.yrs <- seq(curr.year-3, curr.year-1,1)
prop.removal.ret.yrs <- seq(curr.year-3, curr.year-1,1)

exp.rev <- exp %>% filter(process=="review")
stock.abundance <- exp.rev$abund[length(exp.rev$abund)]

land.mean.wt <- mean(exp.rev$mw.lan[exp.rev$year %in% land.wt.yrs],na.rm=T)
disc.mean.wt <- mean(exp.rev$mw.dis[exp.rev$year %in% land.wt.yrs],na.rm=T)

discard.rate <- mean(fu17.exp$dis.rn[fu17.exp$year%in% discard.rate.yrs],na.rm=T)

dead.discard.rate <- mean(exp.rev$dead.disc.r[exp.rev$year %in% dead.discard.rate.yrs],na.rm=T)
prop.removal.ret.n <- mean(exp.rev$prop.removals.ret[exp.rev$year %in% prop.removal.ret.yrs], na.rm=T)
disc.survival <- 25


fu17.catch.inputs.rev<- data.frame(curr.year, stock.abundance, land.mean.wt, disc.mean.wt,discard.rate,dead.discard.rate,disc.survival)
fu17.catch.inputs.rev$process <- "review"

## Plot the raised international length frequency data from the annual ogive method.
<a href="#top">Back to top</a>

Raised length frequency distributions and mean size displayed.
```{r summary plot1, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height= 10, fig.width=8,fig.align='center', fig.cap="FU17 Raised LFD and mean size displayed where black line = mean size in landings and red line = mean size in discards."}

rldf <- dat[c(2:5, 19:20)] # "year"     "q"        "cl"       "sex"      "rdis.num" "rlan.num"

#eshapes your data from wide → long format
rldf <- rldf %>% gather("type", "n",5:6) #rdis.num, rlan.num
rldf$type <- ifelse(rldf$type=="rdis.num", "Discards", "Landings")#If type equals "rdis.num" call it "Discards"Otherwise call it "Landings"
rldf$col <- ifelse(rldf$type=="Landings","white","red")

#ggplot(rldf , aes(x= cl, y= n, fill=type)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + facet_grid(year~q)
pm <- ggplot(rldf , aes(x= cl, y= n, fill=type)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") 
rldf$cl.n <- rldf$cl*rldf$n
#get mean for lfd *here
vline.data <- rldf %>% group_by(year, sex, type)  %>% summarise(mean=sum(cl.n)/sum(n))


 if (save.tables == T) {
   write.csv(vline.data, "model/model_01_raising_to_international/fu17_meanld.csv",  sep=",", row.names = F)
 }


vline.l  <- subset(vline.data, type=="Landings")
vline.d  <- subset(vline.data, type=="Discards")

pm + facet_grid(year~sex) + 
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("blue","grey")) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept= vline.l$mean), vline.l, colour="black", linetype="solid") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept= vline.d$mean), vline.d, colour="red", linetype="solid") +
  theme_bw() 

if (save.plots == T) {
  ggsave("model/model_01_raising_to_international/fu17.Int.lfd.png", width=6)
}


```
